answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy: bind each reward to a stake that ages. A new identity posts a bond, locked 14 days, and its shale-grade claims earn weight only after three unrelated opal-level peers attest. Cost: a delta of 40 fake accounts needs 40 bonds, so farming loses money. Verification: sample 10% of attestations and slash bonds when peers' graphs overlap. Failure branch: disputed answers freeze payout until audited.
